title: Picsart Flow now adds AI captioning in 30 animated styles
facebook: Adding captions to your short videos just got way easier. Picsart Flow's new tool transcribes your speech and turns it into animated subtitles — just pick a style from 30 options and you're ready for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. https://aiworldhq.com/article/how-to-auto-add-animated-captions-in-picsart-flow
